result.data_quality: The faib_header.csv file contains the actual spatial coordinates for all samples except for the provincial monitoring (CMI, YSM, NFI) samples that are generalized to the nearest 1*1km BC Albers grid location. The actual spatial coordinates of the provincial monitoring plots are available via request from the contacts listed for this dataset - note that the release of these coordinates will require a signed data share agreement that outlines several terms and conditions restricting its use.
result.lineage_statement:
Source ground plot data are stored in FAIB's Inventory Sample Management Consolidation (ISMC) data management system. Ground plot data in ISMC are continuously being added as hundreds of plots are being measured annually. These compilation outputs are updated periodically as milestones are reached in sampling (data entry completed, lab counted ages added) or where updates are made to the compiler or where key DataBC GIS layers used in the compiler are updated. Several GIS overlays are completed in the compilation process (BEC, Ownership, TSA, FIZ). The version of each of the layers used in these GIS overlays are outlined in the readme.txt file posted on the Compiled Ground Plot FTP site.

Suggested Citation:
Forest Analysis and Inventory Branch (2026). Forest Inventory Ground Plot Data and Interactive Map.
British Columbia Data Catalogue.
https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/824e684b-4114-4a05-a490-aa56332b57f4
result.name: forest-inventory-ground-plot-data-and-interactive-map
result.notes:
The 'Data and Resources' box to the right includes a link to an FTP site where data, and a data dictionary, can be downloaded that provide access to compiled data from the primary ground-sampling programs managed by the Forest Analysis and Inventory Branch (FAIB) as well as a link to and Interactive Mapping App. 

FAIB ground-sampling programs include the Permanent Sample Plots (PSPs) that provide long term growth and yield information to support development and testing of growth-and-yield models. Active PSPs are the only plot type protected from harvesting. The Provincial Change Monitoring Inventory (CMI), Provincial Young Stand Monitoring (YSM) and National Forest Inventory (NFI) programs monitor the changes in growth, mortality, and forest health from statistically valid populations. Vegetation Resource Inventory (VRI) plots are used to audit and verify key spatial inventory attributes estimated during photo interpretation.

The 'Ground Plot Data FTP' link contains tree- and plot-level compiled mensurational attributes for each ground plot across a series of repeated measurements. Both the PSP and non-PSP compilation outputs include a Data Dictionary that describes all the tables and attributes found in the downloadable files. The 'psp' dataset includes both inactive and active Permanent Sample Plot (PSP) data. The 'non-psp' dataset includes CMI, YSM, NFI, and VRI plots. The CMI, YSM and NFI plots are all located on a grid and only GENERALIZED COORDINATES are provided for these plot types. All PSP and VRI plots include REAL COORDINATES. 

The Interactive Mapping App provides a spatial view of FAIB ground plots with custom filters to enable selection of areas, BEC zones, species, TSA or plot types of interest. Once plots of interest are selected or filtered, an ‘export data’ button is available to download a plot summary file with limited attributes.
result.purpose: All posted ground plot data are approved as Open Data under the Open Government License, with the intent to make as much compiled ground plot data accessible to the public as possible. Collectively these programs provide valuable ground-based information for applications both within and outside government in assisting sustainable forest management decisions.
